note.es: corrida 01:30 UTC = franja asia-2 (desactivada, no vigila ninguna corrida del Session Analyst), sin auto-reparacion que hacer; mercado cerrado desde las 16:00 CT del viernes hasta la reapertura del domingo 17:00 CT (cierre semanal de Globex documentado en instructions.md), por eso snapshot a 272 min, fuentes/orb/command a 286 min, webhook a 286 min y news a 302 min solo reflejan el cierre, no una falla (orb no frozen: fecha y PDH/PDL de los 5 simbolos coinciden con command); SA pre-asia del viernes salio bien (commit 'sa pre-asia 2026-10-10' a las 21:34Z, +29 min vs cron 21:05Z, ok:true); reach ok en los 5 instrumentos (todos TACTICAL, ratio <= 0.26, sin zona inalcanzable); el journal digest sigue parado en 2026-10-05 (103 h), ahora faltan martes 10-06, miercoles 10-07, jueves 10-08 y viernes 10-09 -- unico motivo real del warn
note.en: 01:30 UTC run = the asia-2 slot (disabled, watches no Session Analyst run), so no auto-repair was needed; market closed since Friday 16:00 CT until the Sunday 17:00 CT reopen (Globex weekly close documented in instructions.md), so the 272-min snapshot, 286-min sources/orb/command, 286-min webhook and 302-min news only reflect that closure, not a failure (orb not frozen: date and PDH/PDL for all 5 symbols match command); Friday's SA pre-asia ran fine (commit 'sa pre-asia 2026-10-10' at 21:34Z, +29 min vs the 21:05Z cron, ok:true); reach is ok across all 5 instruments (all TACTICAL, ratio <= 0.26, no unreachable zone); the journal digest is still stuck at 2026-10-05 (103 h), now missing Tuesday 10-06, Wednesday 10-07, Thursday 10-08 and Friday 10-09 -- the only real reason for the warn
